title: Righteousness Theme
summary: Righteousness Theme is a biblical motif that traces righteous justice and covenant accountability across Scripture.
historical_context: Righteousness Theme is read across the canon as Scripture develops this theme from Israel's story into the New Testament witness.
ancient_near_east_context: Ancient covenant, royal, wisdom, and temple backgrounds provide comparison points, but Scripture gives the topic its own theological shape.
literary_context: The topic appears in narrative, poetry, prophecy, Gospel, epistle, and apocalyptic writing as context requires.
covenantal_significance: Righteousness Theme helps show how covenant promises are stated, tested, and fulfilled in Scripture.
interpretive_notes: Read Righteousness Theme in its immediate context before generalizing.
